This file fits a single-level LBA model for Exp 1 in the face familiarity study.

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

pkgs <- c(
  "EMC2", "tidyverse", "here", "parallel", "future"
  )
vapply(
  pkgs, library, logical(1), character.only = TRUE, logical.return = TRUE
  )

## set options
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores(),
        future.fork.enable = TRUE,
        future.rng.onMisuse = "ignore") ## automatically set in RStudio

supportsMulticore()

detectCores()

plan(multicore)

```

# 1. read in the raw data and wrangle

raw data

```{r}
raw <- read_csv(here("exp_1", "data", "data_exp_1.csv"))
head(raw)
glimpse(raw)
```

wrangle 

```{r}
data_emc <- raw |>
  select(pid, cond, keypress, rt) |>
  rename(subjects = pid, S = cond, R = keypress) |>
  mutate(
    subjects = factor(subjects),
    S = factor(S,
      levels = c("Novel", "Learned")
    ),
    R = if_else(R == "q", "Learned", "Novel"),
    R = factor(R,
      levels = c("Novel", "Learned")
    )
  ) |>
  as.data.frame() ## in EMC, post predict needs a df and not a tibble..
head(data_emc)
glimpse(data_emc)
```

# 2. Preregistered model

## 2.1 Build model

```{r}
#| label: matchfun

matchfun <- function(d) d$S == d$lR
```

```{r}
#| label: design

design_exp1 <- design(
  data = data_emc,
  model = LBA,
  matchfun = matchfun,
  formula = list(
    v  ~ 0 + S:lM,
    sv ~ 0 + lM,
    B  ~ 0 + lR,
    A  ~ 1,
    t0 ~ 1
  ),
  constants = c(sv_lMFALSE = log(1))
)
```

```{r}
#| label: p-vector

p_vector <- c(
  "v_SNovel:lMFALSE"   = 4, "v_SLearned:lMFALSE" = 4,
  "v_SNovel:lMTRUE"    = 4, "v_SLearned:lMTRUE"  = 4,
  sv_lMTRUE            = log(.5),
  B_lRNovel            = log(2), B_lRLearned = log(2),
  A                    = log(.5), t0 = log(.3)
)

mapped_pars(p_vector, x = design_exp1)
```

```{r}
#| label: priors

mu_mean <- c(
  "v_SNovel:lMFALSE"   = 0, "v_SLearned:lMFALSE" = 0,
  "v_SNovel:lMTRUE"    = 1, "v_SLearned:lMTRUE"  = 1,
  sv_lMTRUE            = log(.5),
  B_lRNovel            = log(1), B_lRLearned = log(1),
  A                    = log(.5), t0 = log(.3)
)

mu_sd <- c(
  "v_SNovel:lMFALSE"   = 2, "v_SLearned:lMFALSE" = 2,
  "v_SNovel:lMTRUE"    = 2, "v_SLearned:lMTRUE"  = 2,
  sv_lMTRUE            = .5,
  B_lRNovel            = .5, B_lRLearned = .5,
  A                    = .3, t0 = .3
)

prior_exp1 <- prior(
  design_exp1,
  type  = "single",
  pmean = mu_mean,
  psd   = mu_sd
)

plot(x = prior_exp1)
```

## 2.2 Fit model

```{r}
#| label: fit
#| eval: false

LBA_exp1 <- make_emc(
  data_emc, 
  design_exp1,
  type = "single", 
  prior = prior_exp1,
  compress = TRUE
)

LBA_exp1 <- fit(
  LBA_exp1,
  cores_for_chains = 3,
  cores_per_chain = 9,
  iter            = 3000,
  step_size       = 500,
  verbose         = TRUE,
  fileName        = here("exp_1", "models", "single", "tmp.RData")
)

saveRDS(LBA_exp1, "exp_1/models/single/LBA_exp1_single.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: load

LBA_exp1 <- readRDS("exp_1/models/single/LBA_exp1_single.rds")
```

## 2.4 Posterior predictions

```{r}
#| label: posterior-predictions
#| eval: false

pp_LBA_exp1 <- predict(LBA_exp1, n_cores = 28)
saveRDS(pp_LBA_exp1, "exp_1/models/single/pp_LBA_exp1.rds")
```

```{r}
#| label: plot-fit

pp_LBA_exp1 <- readRDS("exp_1/models/single/pp_LBA_exp1.rds")

## exp 1 folder
png("exp_1/figures/single/pp_density.png", width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 150)
plot_density(
  data_emc, 
  pp_LBA_exp1, 
  factors = "S"
)
dev.off()

png("exp_1/figures/single/pp_cdf.png", width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 150)
plot_cdf(
  data_emc,
  pp_LBA_exp1,  
  factors = "S"
)
dev.off()
```
